title: Indian-Style Pasta Pilaf
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of Indian cuisine with a Western-style pasta pilaf. Yellowed onions add a sweet and caramelized depth to the dish.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add pasta, pilaf, and Ukrainian sauce (if using).
Stir well and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh cilantro (if desired).
